triage.title: A scraper hammers the exporter
triage.why: Unusual and loud, but the exporter only serves aggregated reports. Contained automatically and logged; nobody is paged.

triage.title: Credential stuffing that keeps failing
triage.why: Hundreds of 401s from rotating addresses. Contained automatically and logged; nobody is paged.

triage.title: Credential stuffing that lands, then a write
triage.why: A login succeeds and the account's email changes. Contained automatically and logged; nobody is paged.

triage.title: Stolen token, limit raise, $9,800 transfer
triage.why: The hero case: a limit raise, then a transfer to a new payee. A person on the IT team is paged.

triage.title: SSRF probe on webhooks
triage.why: A webhook pointed at an internal metadata address. A person on the IT team is paged.

triage.title: Enumeration finds an old API version
triage.why: 403s on /v1, then 200s on /v0 for records the caller does not own. A person on the IT team is paged.
